answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one ember weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 139 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 263 times the capital for one share. The voyage report reveals the merge explicitly at each raven. A farm of 2542 identities would post 763 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
